images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of Qwen-Image-PE.(a)Supervised fine-tuning with Caption-Based Reverse Distillation (CRD) trains the enhancer to imitate design choices described in dense captions of well-designed images.(b)Reinforcement learning with Groupwise Design Reward (GDR) refines lighting, composition, layout, and detail by jointly scoring images for the same request, using the full rollout group.

Figure 3:Motivating Caption-Based Reverse Distillation.(a)Dense captions of well-designed images guide Qwen-Image-2.1 to reproduce key visual design choices in lighting, composition, layout, and detail.(b)In the t-SNE projection, Qwen-Image-PE-397B prompt embeddings overlap more with embeddings of sampled T2I training captions than forward-based prompt embeddings do.

Figure 5:Qualitative comparisons across four design dimensions.In these examples, prompts from Qwen-Image-PE-397B yield more expressive lighting, more cohesive compositions, better-organized layouts, and richer details than original requests or prompts from baseline enhancers.
